dos.text: Call .focus()/.click()/.blur() directly on moz-visual-picker-item, they're overridden to delegate into the inner shadow DOM button (itemEl) rather than acting on the light DOM host.

donts.text: Don't expect an aria-labelledby fallback wired from slotted content to update after the fact, handleSlotchange() only assigns itemEl.ariaLabelledByElements once, in response to a slotchange event, and only when neither label nor ariaLabel was set at that time.
Don't expect the title attribute to work as a normal tooltip directly on moz-visual-picker-item, it's mapped (mapped: true) onto the inner shadow DOM button and stripped from the host element.
